name: Anthropic
billing: Check the Claude Console billing page and available API credits. Access and limits are specific to your organization and workspace.
steps: Sign in or create an account in the Claude Console. Select the organization and workspace for your application.
Open API keys, choose Create key, give it a name and expiration, and select yourself or the service account that should own it. Scope it to the intended workspace.
Copy the key once into your own secret storage. If your role cannot create keys, ask the organization administrator.
